config.description: Override the default image model (default: gemini-nano-banana-2.1)

config.label: Default directory for generated images (default: ~/Downloads/gemini-mcp)
config.description: Default directory for generated images (default: ~/Downloads/gemini-mcp). When set, a per-call output_dir must be inside it.

config.label: Directory to resolve bare input-image filenames against
config.description: Directory to resolve bare input-image filenames against

config.label: Restrict local-file uploads to the Gemini Files API to these directories (path
config.description: Restrict local-file uploads to the Gemini Files API to these directories (path.delimiter-separated; unset = unrestricted)

config.label: Restrict local reference images (images / image paths sent to Gemini) to these directories (path
config.description: Restrict local reference images (images / image paths sent to Gemini) to these directories (path.delimiter-separated), plus GEMINI_OUTPUT_DIR. Unset: GEMINI_UPLOAD_DIR applies; if that is unset too, unrestricted locally, and $MCP_DATA_DIR/uploads when MCP_DATA_DIR is set (hosted)

config.label: Upstream request timeout in ms (default: 60000, or 120000 for image_size: "4K"); each generation tool also takes a per-call timeout_ms
config.description: Upstream request timeout in ms (default: 60000, or 120000 for image_size: "4K"); each generation tool also takes a per-call timeout_ms

config.label: Progress-notification cadence in ms while a generation runs (default: 10000; 0 disables) — keeps MCP hosts that reset their timeout on progress from timing out long generations
config.description: Progress-notification cadence in ms while a generation runs (default: 10000; 0 disables) — keeps MCP hosts that reset their timeout on progress from timing out long generations

config.label: How long to wait out interactions-store lag when a chained call 404s (default: 120000; 0 disables retrying)
config.description: How long to wait out interactions-store lag when a chained call 404s (default: 120000; 0 disables retrying)

config.label: When set, emit heartbeat diagnostics to stderr
config.description: When set, emit heartbeat diagnostics to stderr. Off by default.

config.label: Override/extend the shipped USD-per-1M-token rates used by gemini_token_usage's cost estimate, e
config.description: Override/extend the shipped USD-per-1M-token rates used by gemini_token_usage's cost estimate, e.g. {"gemini-3-pro-image":{"input":2,"text_output":12,"image_output":120}}. Malformed JSON is ignored (a bad card must not fail generations).
